MappingFields.Name: PASSWORD
MappingFields.Description: [Required] Randomly generated initial Oracle password. Do not send this value by plain-text email.

MappingFields.Name: USER_ID
MappingFields.Description: [Read-only] Oracle-generated user identifier, imported for reconciliation.

MappingFields.Name: ACCOUNT_STATUS
MappingFields.Description: [Read-only] Oracle account status, imported to determine whether the account is enabled.

MappingFields.Name: USERNAME
MappingFields.Description: [Required] Oracle username. Defaults to the Active Directory sAMAccountName in uppercase; replace MicrosoftActiveDirectory with the system name of the installed Active Directory target system and confirm the username convention during implementation.
